historical_design_observations.user3_source_behavior: Six status flags are synchronized through two stages, loaded into the low bits of a 32-bit shift register on capture, shifted toward TDO, and TDI is not consumed by this source path.
historical_design_observations.qualification_limit: These RTL facts do not establish loaded-image identity, instruction opcode/register encoding, real-device response, non-mutation in the deployed image, or approval of a physical test.

expected_response.note: No expected BSCAN response or permitted variation is supplied by the existing Case B matrix. Do not substitute a simulated value or infer a literal from RTL.

replay_and_provenance.requirement: Reject stale, replayed, cross-session, simulated, unsigned, or mismatched captures.
replay_and_provenance.software_binding: Current validators require trusted-role Ed25519 signatures, fresh capture time, exact Case B ID and v5.1 qualification-record hash, current session nonce, nonempty raw bytes with matching SHA256, and hash-matched physical clock-correlation bytes.
replay_and_provenance.current_bscan_gate: The immutable Case B binding must contain an approved observation schema and exact expected observation; those fields are absent and the validator refuses.

raw_evidence_and_cryptographic_provenanc.canonicalization_and_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 for evidence artifact hashes; current signed wrappers use canonical JSON and Ed25519

known_abort_conditions: Any card, adapter, chain, image, route, bridge, authorization, peer, or hash mismatch.
Expired authorization, changed session nonce, stale or replayed evidence, or signature/provenance failure.
Unexpected TAP state, instruction, TDO/observation value, transition, clock count, or timing/correlation result.
Any workload/image mutation, disconnect, extra client, journal/capture failure, or uncertain idle/close state.
abort_and_recovery.recovery_rule: Stop immediately; do not retry, reconnect, reset, program, or change workload. Preserve lock and evidence and use a separately authorized recovery owner if final state is uncertain.

No method is currently pinned, so validation refuses.
software_compatibility_gate.required_before_execution: Qualification owner must approve and pin the exact method hash and expected observation in the immutable Case B record; then independently review tests for that exact sequence and response. Keep physical execution disabled until then.
